title: Simon 2.8: BV extension estimate on convex sets (frozen BVExtensionEstimate)
statement: (Simon Ch. 2, Lemma 2.8, frozen contract BVExtensionEstimate.) For all n ∈ ℕ and δ ∈ (0,1) there is C ≥ 0 such that for every bounded open convex U ⊆ ℝⁿ, R > 0, ξ ∈ U with closedBall(ξ,δR) ⊆ U ⊆ closedBall(ξ,R), and every u with IsBVOn univ u (u ∈ L¹(ℝⁿ), bvVariationOn u univ < ∞) and u = 0 a.e. off closure U: bvVariationOn u (closure U)ᶜ = 0 and bvVariationOn u univ ≤ ofReal C·(bvVariationOn u U + ofReal R⁻¹·∫⁻_U ‖u‖ₑ).
